reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM, but I didn't save the Thursday 16:30 Quarrendon Freight Lines call to memory. Anything I store there gets loaded into every conversation, including other members', so saving it would carry his DM into their chats. I told him that in the reply.

Instead, I offered to set up a weekly Thursday 16:30 calendar event so he has a lasting record. I haven't created it, since he said no action was needed. I'll make it if he says yes.
